description:
Job Description
 





 Internship Opportunity: Website Testing \& QA Intern
 





 Company: Sunsys Techsol Pvt. Ltd.
 





 Location
 
**: Remote** 

 (PAN India)
 





 Duration:
 
**3 Months** 





 Timing: Flexible (Part\-time, 5 to 6 hours/day)
 





 Stipend:
 
**Unpaid** 




**Perks \& Benefits:** 





 • Internship Completion Certificate
 





 • Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
 





 • LinkedIn Recommendation from Official Company Page
 





 • Mentorship from Senior QA Engineers \& Web Development Team
 





 • Hands\-on Live Website Testing Projects
 





 • Exposure to Real\-world QA Processes \& Agile Environment
 





 • Flexible Working Hours (Output\-based Work Model)
 




**About Sunsys Techsol Pvt. Ltd.:** 





 Sunsys Techsol is an innovation\-driven organization working across IT Services, Renewable Energy, and Digital Platform Solutions. We build social\-impact platforms in skill development, education, mobility, and inclusion. We promote a remote\-first, growth\-focused learning culture.
 




**Role Overview:** 





 We are looking for a Website Testing \& QA Intern with strong attention to detail and passion for improving user experience. You will test and validate live web platforms and work closely with product and development teams to ensure smooth functionality.
 




**Key Responsibilities:** 





 • Test websites for functionality, bugs, UI issues, responsiveness, and performance
 





 • Identify layout/UI/UX inconsistencies and report them clearly
 





 • Document bugs and track progress using tools like Notion / Trello / GitHub / Jira
 





 • Perform manual testing across browsers and devices (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Android, iOS)
 





 • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new releases
 





 • Coordinate with developers for improvements and bug resolution
 




**Required Skills:** 





 • Understanding of basic web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
 





 • Ability to perform cross\-browser and responsive testing
 





 • Good observation and problem\-solving skills
 





 • Ability to write clear bug reports
 





 • Basic understanding of UI/UX flow
 




**Preferred / Bonus Skills:** 





 • Familiarity with tools like Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or JMeter
 





 • Knowledge of Git/GitHub
 





 • Awareness of web performance and security testing basics
 




**Eligibility:** 





 • Pursuing or completed B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc. (CS/IT) or equivalent
 





 • Final\-year students and freshers are welcome
 



**Industry** 


 ●     IT Services and IT Consulting
 



**Employment Type** 


 Internship
 





 Apply here:
 
 hr@sunsysglobal.com
